Definition: to tap, i.e. beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to thrust, impel, push, beat persistently; 1a) (Qal) to impel; 1b) (Niphal) to be beaten, be disturbed; 1c) (Hithpael) to be disturbed
